DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • The Death Knight has Pillar of Frost active, or does not have the Pillar of Frost talent selected
  • AND one of these is true: they have the Obliteration talent, they have an active Breath of Sindragosa with its matching talent, or they have neither Breath of Sindragosa nor Obliteration talents selected
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • There is at least 1 enemy and their rotation is focused on single-target or priority adds.
  • Summon Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining, or if Unholy is using Army of the Dead alongside Ghoul/Abomination summons with <18 seconds remaining.
  • Dark Transformation is active and they aren’t using Gargoyle/Army of the Dead talents.
  • Gargoyle isn’t active and its cooldown won’t be ready within 10 seconds of Power Infusion’s duration.
  • There are ≥3 enemies with either Dark Transformation active or Death and Decay ticking.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They are under the effects of Metamorphosis (their primary DPS cooldown)
  • The boss fight will end within 20 seconds and optimal timing isn't possible
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • They activate Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune, ensuring alignment with their major damage window.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Feral Druid has Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane active, enhancing their burst damage window.
  • The Feral Druid has not selected the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent, as their primary cooldown relies on Incarnation.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Dragonrage is active and either Shattering Star is on cooldown, its debuff is present on the target, or there are 2 or more enemies.
  • The fight will end in less than 35 seconds.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • The Hunter is under the effect of Trueshot with more than 12 seconds remaining on its duration.
  • The encounter will end within the next 13 seconds, allowing a final use of Power Infusion before combat concludes.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Their Coordinated Assault is active during a burst window.
  • They do not have the Coordinated Assault talent, but Spearhead is off cooldown and ready to use.
  • They lack both Coordinated Assault and Spearhead talents, aligning with their primary damage phase or on cooldown.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They do NOT have Spymaster’s Web equipped and just cast Arcane Surge.
  • They have Spymaster’s Web equipped and just cast Evocation.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Their Combustion cooldown will be ready within the required setup time and Power Infusion isn’t already active.
  • They currently have Combustion active with over 7 seconds remaining on its duration.
  • The encounter will end in less than 20 seconds (to avoid wasting charges).
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • The Mage does not have Power Infusion active (buff.power_infusion.down).
  • Coordinated during their Icy Veins window or burst phase for maximum damage amplification, as per Frost Mage priority guides.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is summoned and active, and either:
  • Bloodlust is not active, or
  • Bloodlust is active but Strike of the Windlord hasn’t cooled down yet
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • When the Paladin activates Avenging Wrath, their primary offensive cooldown.
  • When the Paladin uses Crusade (if talented), as it ramps up their haste and damage output.
  • When Execution Sentence is applied to the target, amplifying its delayed damage effect.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • The Shadow Priest has Voidform active and Power Infusion is not already active.
  • The Shadow Priest is under the effect of Dark Ascension and Power Infusion is not already active.
  • The Shadow Priest has their Tier Set 4-piece bonus active and Power Infusion is not already active.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • The Rogue has an active Deathmark effect applied to their target to amplify its damage.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • The Rogue has Shadow Dance active, enhancing their burst damage phase with empowered abilities.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • The Shaman's Ascendance is currently active.
  • The Shaman's Ascendance cooldown has more than 30 seconds remaining.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • They activate Ascendance, summon Feral Spirits, or trigger Doom Winds.
  • The encounter duration is within the final 20 seconds of a time window (e.g., before a phase transition or boss enrage).
  • Their shortest talented offensive cooldown has over 120 seconds remaining before reuse.
  • They do NOT have Ascendance, Feral Spirits, or Doom Winds talented, requiring minimal coordination.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • Their rotation aligns with Summon Darkglare and other key offensive cooldowns, as this indicates an active damage window where Power Infusion will amplify their burst potential.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Wild Imps are about to despawn within the next 2 GCDs plus Summon Demonic Tyrant's cast time.
  • The Warlock just cast Hand of Gul'dan or Ruination immediately beforehand.
  • Either: the same Imps will expire within 1 GCD plus the Tyrant’s cast time, or the Warlock has fewer than 2 Soul Shards for follow-up abilities.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • The warlock's Infernal is currently active.
  • The warlock is not using the Summon Infernal talent.
  • The encounter will end before another Infernal can be summoned, but lasts long enough to fully benefit from Power Infusion's duration.
  • The remaining encounter time is less than 15 seconds after the warlock's next Infernal cooldown becomes available.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • the target has Colossus Smash debuff active and the fight duration is at least 135 seconds remaining.
  • the target is in Execute phase (below 20% health) and the Warrior has Avatar active.
  • the fight has 25 seconds or less remaining, regardless of other conditions.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has over 15 seconds remaining and the fight will last at least 135 more seconds
  • The target is in Execute Phase (below 20% health) and Avatar is active
  • The fight will end in 25 seconds or less
